What's new in DuckOS 1.0.91

• DuckPay: the card glows in its own colour behind it, and the glow breathes once you've confirmed it's you.
• DuckPay: drag the card down and all your cards fan out from it. The one you pick flies to the top.
• DuckWallet: pull the cards down and they spread apart, then spring back. An open card glows in its colour.
• Settings > Updates lists what's new one point at a time.
